quotes: For traders using the Stellar 2-Step or Stellar Lite Account, the On-Demand Performance Reward is now a built-in payout option — no add-on purchase required.
You must have maintained the 40% consistency rule across your trades.

The 40% consistency rule means that your best trading day's profit should not exceed 40% of your total generated profit at the time of your request. It is important to note that this is not a daily profit cap; it is only evaluated when you submit an on-demand request.

allocation.explanation: $300K is the cap on simultaneously held funded (FundedNext-phase) simulated capital bought through challenges ($200K for Stellar Lite; $50K in 8 listed countries). $4M is the ceiling a single funded account can be grown to through the scale-up programme after qualifying cycles; it is not purchasable.
